checkpoint-diff.description: Read what one turn changed: the diff of a checkpoint against the pane's checkpoint before it, or against HEAD when it was taken for the first one. Nothing in the repository, its index or its working tree is changed. The text is the repository's, so it is marked untrusted.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

params.name: n
params.description: The checkpoint. Omit for the newest.

params.name: paths
params.description: Only these paths, relative to the repository root. Omit for every changed file.

params.name: context
params.description: Lines of context around each change, 0 to 20.

returns.name: session
returns.description: The session of the pane.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The pane, by id.

returns.name: worktree
returns.description: The root of the work tree.

returns.name: checkpoint
returns.description: The checkpoint read: n, ref, commit, tree, head, kind (turn or safety), pane, session, turn, state, label, worktree, at (Unix nanoseconds), and skipped and skipped_count (the untracked files left out as larger than max_untracked_mb, omitted when none).

returns.name: base
returns.description: What the diff runs from: checkpoint N, HEAD <hash>, or an empty tree.

returns.name: base_tree
returns.description: The tree the diff runs from.

returns.name: files
returns.description: One entry per changed file, as review-diff returns them.

returns.name: totals
returns.description: files, added and removed over the whole diff.

returns.name: truncated
returns.description: The diff passed a cap (400 files, 2 MiB, 5000 lines in a file) and the files past it carry counts only.

returns.name: untrusted
returns.description: Always true: the text is the repository's, not the daemon's.

list-checkpoints.description: List the checkpoints of a pane: the state of its git work tree, saved each time its agent finished a turn that changed a file, and before each restore. Oldest first. The labels are the agent's prompts, so the result is marked untrusted.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

returns.name: session
returns.description: The session of the pane.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The pane, by id.

returns.name: worktree
returns.description: The root of the work tree the pane is in, symbolic links resolved.

returns.name: enabled
returns.description: Whether checkpoints are taken: [agents.checkpoints] enabled.

returns.name: keep
returns.description: How many checkpoints one pane keeps: [agents.checkpoints] keep.

returns.name: checkpoints
returns.description: One entry per checkpoint: n, ref, commit, tree, head, kind (turn or safety), pane, session, turn, state, label, worktree, at (Unix nanoseconds), and skipped and skipped_count (the untracked files left out as larger than max_untracked_mb, omitted when none).

returns.name: untrusted
returns.description: Always true: the labels are the agent's text.

restore-checkpoint.description: Put a pane's git work tree back to a checkpoint. The work tree is first saved as a safety checkpoint, so the restore can be undone by restoring that one. Only files that differ are written or removed. The index, HEAD, the branch and ignored files are not changed. Refused while the pane's agent is working or waiting on a prompt, unless force is given.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

params.name: force
params.description: Restore while the agent is mid-turn.

returns.name: session
returns.description: The session of the pane.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The pane, by id.

returns.name: worktree
returns.description: The root of the work tree.

returns.name: restored
returns.description: The checkpoint restored.

returns.name: safety
returns.description: The checkpoint that holds the work tree as it was before the restore. Restore it to undo.

returns.name: written
returns.description: The files written from the checkpoint.

returns.name: removed
returns.description: The files removed, which the checkpoint does not have.

returns.name: skipped
returns.description: The submodules that differ from the checkpoint. A restore does not change a submodule.
